One row per indexed record; click the test name for the record's page. `kind` says what a row is: a single physical test, a series averaged from unidentified tests, a series derived from identified tests, an author's correlation, a text-only summary, or a bin sample. Rows are not independent tests unless `kind` is `single`. Sort by any column; the filter box matches any field, including printed labels such as `LPT 27` or `SSD 4-18`.
